notes:
The Austrian partition zone, a state Cliopatria lacks (its Habsburg Monarchy shapes draw the land; eu-15 asked for the partition zones year by year). Typed colony (Habsburg crown land drawn as a tint of the metropole; family austria). The scope of eu-15 is to 1789, but the crown land is the 1772, 1795 and 1815 zone and lives to 1918; events after 1815 rest on the one Kingdom page.

Not settled: (1) The extent of West Galicia in 1795: the Third Partition page gives no town or area; the Lublin and Świętokrzyskie voivodeships are a reading, and Kraków city is treated as Third Partition land. (2) The Zator and Auschwitz incorporation date is not on the Kingdom page (First Partition page lists them in the 1772 share). (3) The month of the Treaty of Schönbrunn is on no page opened. (4) 1873: 'Galicia was de facto an autonomous province'; 1867 the Ausgleich; no border change. (5) Counterparts needing dossiers: west-ukrainian-people-s-republic (Oct 1918-1919), and a Duchy of Bukovina (crown land from 1849). (6) The Russian zones of 1772, 1793 and 1795 (Minsk and Izyaslav viceroyalties, the Podolian and Volhynian viceroyalties) are Russian provinces without their own Wikipedia state pages opened here; the Prussian zones are south-prussia, new-east-prussia and west-prussia.
